title: Mans Carpio says questioned credit card transactions were personal expenses, not linked to VP Duterte
summary: Atty. Manases "Mans" Carpio said on Saturday that credit card transactions raised during the impeachment proceedings against his wife, Vice President Sara Duterte, were personal expenditures paid…

blocks.text: Atty. Manases "Mans" Carpio said on Saturday that credit card transactions raised during the impeachment proceedings against his wife, Vice President Sara Duterte, were personal expenditures paid using his own funds and should not be associated with the vice president or her official duties.
